budget_category_named.name: budget_category_named
budget_category_named.value: "budget_category"."system_key" IS NOT NULL OR "budget_category"."name" IS NOT NULL

budget_line_one_payer.name: budget_line_one_payer
budget_line_one_payer.value: ("budget_line"."split_mode" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'one_payer') = ("budget_line"."payer_membership_id" IS NOT NULL)

income_line_label_length.name: income_line_label_length
income_line_label_length.value: "income_line"."label" IS NULL OR char_length(btrim("income_line"."label")) BETWEEN 1 AND 40

recurring_txn_rule_member_methods.name: recurring_txn_rule_member_methods
recurring_txn_rule_member_methods.value: "recurring_txn_rule"."payment_method" NOT IN ('personal_card', 'meal_voucher') OR "recurring_txn_rule"."payer_membership_id" IS NOT NULL

txn_member_methods.name: txn_member_methods
txn_member_methods.value: "txn"."payment_method" NOT IN ('personal_card', 'meal_voucher') OR "txn"."payer_membership_id" IS NOT NULL
